newsitem.title: USA: Amcore in asset management deal.
newsitem.headline: Amcore in asset management deal.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Tuesday it plans to combine its asset management operations with Investors Management Group, Iowa's largest independent asset manager.

This will form an investment management firm with more than $3.5 billion in assets under management. The new organization, headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa, will be known as Investors Management Group and will be owned by Amcore Investment Group NA, one of five financial service companies owned by Amcore.
After the merger, Amcore said its investment management organization will rank in the top 15 percent of asset managers based on assets under management.

"The different areas of expertise each company brings to the table will create great synergy and unique market opportunities," Alan Kennebeck, president of Amcore Investment Group, said in a statement.
Amcore Capital Management is an equity management firm with $1.8 billion in assets under management. It is the advisor and manager of the Amcore Vintage family of mutual funds.

Amcore said its equity management team and its distribution system targeted at high net worth and retail investors will complement Investors Management's institutional account business. It will target customers in Iowa, Illinois and Wisconsin.

Investors Management has $1.7 billion in assets under management. It manages stock, bond and money market portfolios for financial institutions, government bodies, businesses, pension plans, foundations and individuals.
The deal is subject to due diligence, the execution of a definitive agreement and customary regulatory approvals.
